scope: The named campaign routes A-F and their outstanding mathematical obligations. This is not a claim to enumerate every possible future proof of the MUB6 problem.
edge_semantics: Each route requires every input. Distinct routes with the same output are alternatives. Supporting computations do not discharge an exclusion unless explicitly included in a valid route.

non_discharge_notes: A-F, A-T, A-H, B, and C only address their stated subsets; no five-family coverage edge is asserted.
B-cusp and B-arc do not imply B without a proved exhaustive cover and candidate exclusion on every chart.
G, S, A-T-eval, and E-polar do not independently imply Q.
No result or route in this graph establishes a publication, deposit, or authority promotion.
D-minor supplies quantitative bounds, not retained finite-fibre coverage or an exclusion edge to Q.
D-bounded and D-external are separate coverage routes. Their domain intersection is not asserted to retain coverage. The bounded equations do not discharge X-bounded.

D-bounded-polynomials checks a global semialgebraic reduction, not emptiness. The determinant inequality and all 396 indexed equalities must be retained; the closed coordinate box is not a finite search grid.
Degree bounds and finite coefficient identities do not establish infeasibility, sharp degree or independence. Runtime expansion probes do not establish whole-export byte parity.
Complete coefficient export and exact probes do not discharge X-bounded. Runtime byte replay is separate from kernel reflection of the serialized file.
D-mu-factor retains all 396 equations through 36 exact replacements, the closed box and q >= 54/5. A smaller coefficient representation is not an infeasibility certificate.

D-quadratic-lift checks full matrices without determinant division. It does not remove q >= 54/5 from the earlier reconstruction/cancellation models or discharge X-quadratic-lift. More ambient coordinates with lower polynomial degree are not an exclusion certificate.

D-quadratic-coefficients reflects literal coefficient rows and bounds. JSON parsing and hashing remain external. The 4920 monomials, 2592 exact probes and byte parity do not exclude a quartet or establish solver complexity.

D-quadratic-narrow-box preserves the global existence equivalence in a smaller box. The native sweep reports CONTRACTED_UNRESOLVED_BOX. Native parsing and the general contractor are not kernel reflected; the Lean theorem independently checks this specific narrowing. X-quadratic-lift remains open.

X-close-columns excludes only the specified regional box and the family described by its Lean theorem. Every original polynomial range can contain zero while the new distance criterion excludes the box. This does not provide a global cover, covered fraction, quartet witness, or kernel reflection of JSON and native execution.

D-balanced-quadratic preserves actual quartet existence while eliminating 66 ambient real coordinates. It does not prove independence, solver speedup, or infeasibility. Arbitrary points in the reduced box can expand outside the old box; recovered bounds hold on solutions. Earlier native receipts remain for 386 coordinates.

D-balanced-coefficients has checked semantic coefficients and a complete export including 42 empty rows. Full literal-table kernel replay remains unfinished. Exact probe parity and coefficient density do not prove infeasibility or computational superiority. Existing native receipts remain for the unchanged 386-coordinate model.
